expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: AccessList resource definition v1 from Teleport

audit.description: audit describes the frequency that this Access List must be audited.

next_audit_date.description: next_audit_date is when the next audit date should be done by.

notifications.description: notifications is the configuration for notifying users.

start.description: start specifies when to start notifying users that the next audit date is coming up.

day_of_month.description: day_of_month is the day of month that reviews will be scheduled on. Supported values are 0, 1, 15, and 31.

frequency.description: frequency is the frequency of reviews. This represents the period in months between two reviews. Supported values are 0, 1, 3, 6, and 12.

description.description: description is an optional plaintext description of the Access List.

grants.description: grants describes the access granted by membership to this Access List.

roles.description: roles are the roles that are granted to users who are members of the Access List.

traits.description: traits are the traits that are granted to users who are members of the Access List.

membership_requires.description: membership_requires describes the requirements for a user to be a member of the Access List. For a membership to an Access List to be effective, the user must meet the requirements of Membership_requires and must be in the members list.

roles.description: roles are the user roles that must be present for the user to obtain access.

traits.description: traits are the traits that must be present for the user to obtain access.

owner_grants.description: owner_grants describes the access granted by owners to this Access List.

roles.description: roles are the roles that are granted to users who are members of the Access List.

traits.description: traits are the traits that are granted to users who are members of the Access List.

owners.description: owners is a list of owners of the Access List.

description.description: description is the plaintext description of the owner and why they are an owner.

ineligible_status.description: ineligible_status describes if this owner is eligible or not and if not, describes how they're lacking eligibility.

membership_kind.description: membership_kind describes the type of membership, either `MEMBERSHIP_KIND_USER` or `MEMBERSHIP_KIND_LIST`.

name.description: name is the username of the owner.

ownership_requires.description: ownership_requires describes the requirements for a user to be an owner of the Access List. For ownership of an Access List to be effective, the user must meet the requirements of ownership_requires and must be in the owners list.

roles.description: roles are the user roles that must be present for the user to obtain access.

traits.description: traits are the traits that must be present for the user to obtain access.

title.description: title is a plaintext short description of the Access List.

type.description: type can be an empty string which denotes a regular Access List, "scim" which represents an Access List created from SCIM group or "static" for Access Lists managed by IaC tools.
